full_text:
Sebastián Lelio has sadly passed away.

He will go down in history as the director of the first Chilean film to win the Oscar for Best International Feature Film with ‘A FANTASTIC WOMAN’

He went on to direct acclaimed films starring Florence Pugh, Julianne Moore, Rachel Weisz and Rachel McAdams.
